data_quality.feature_usage_granularity: weekly rollups, date = Monday of the week

mrr_definition: sum over accounts with >=1 paid non-zero invoice and not canceled at that time; monthly amount, annual/12; internal excluded

trial_to_paid.definition: accounts with >=1 paid non-zero invoice / accounts whose 14-day trial ended

churn.first_renewal_definition: monthly account canceled after exactly one paid charge (the trial-end charge), i.e. before/at the second charge
churn.annual_caveat: no annual plan has reached its first renewal inside the window (first renewals start 2026-12); annual retention is partly prepayment lock-in, cancel_at_period_end shows intent

involuntary_churn.reading: P0: no dunning (single attempt, canceled on first failure); enable Smart Retries + card-update emails, backend/Stripe setting only

reports_viewed.note: correlation; reports users skew to bank-sync accounts

existing_plan_verdicts.ai_invoice_writer: contradicted/unsupported: only 6 of 501 tickets mention AI; churn is driven by bank sync failure and no dunning
existing_plan_verdicts.pricing_page_redesign: not supported as top priority: trial-to-paid is decent; the loss is after the first charge
existing_plan_verdicts.enterprise_tier: not supported: 10 paid Pro accounts at the 5-seat cap, 3 seat requests
existing_plan_verdicts.missing: dunning/retries (P0), bank sync reliability for Revolut/Monzo/Wise etc., onboarding to bank sync before first renewal, surfacing reports, annual plan nudge
